title_sq: Ne Laprake Tek Pallatet E Arabit , Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt Dhe Hapesira Te Bollshme!

title_en: In Laprake, at Palacet E Arabi, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan and ample space!
description_en: At Palatet E Arabi in Laprake, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan and ample space!!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a 12-story building and has a gross area of ​​108 m2, of which 99 m2 is net. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room together with kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, toilet and balcony. The apartment is located in a well-managed building equipped with an elevator. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas with all the facilities for a comfortable life. The property has full mortgage documentation.
